_comment: ready-1 P2 stats share card: new shareStats namespace, 24 keys. latencyValue carries per-locale CLDR plural categories (ar zero/one/two/few/many/other; pl/ru/uk one/few/many/other; id/ja/ko/th/vi/zh-Hans/zh-Hant other only; the rest one/other). Placeholders: {{count}} on latencyValue, {{sampled}} and {{total}} on latencyCoverage. No em dashes anywhere - house rule for user-facing copy. Never edit the 20 dictionaries by hand.
